summary: Added four interactive question-placement prototypes: expanded node, floating card, bottom drawer, and focus overlay. Compare answer and research views with sample data using npm run prototype:layouts. The installed canvas layout is unchanged.
Documented the required version-and-publish workflow so each completed iteration is available to install from main under a new plugin version.
Explore an idea in a branching question map inside Copilot. Research alternatives, save your answers, and export a Markdown record plus a file you can reopen.
